name: net_hand_back_at_window
description: Client 2's game hangs for 7 s in the middle of wave 2: AWAY, the caretaker plays its seat. Its first word after the hang brings BACK, and both simulations mark the seat returning, not present: while the wave runs, the seat's own BUILD is refused as the caretaker's (CARETAKEN, 'The caretaker hands back at the next build window') and nothing is built. The seat is handed back on the very tick the next build window opens, and from then on its orders go through: its Ready sounds the horn early (seat 1's bot is Ready), and with the early gold the BUILD refused before builds its tower. The hashes agree throughout.

steps.msg: silent 5 s: AWAY; its first word after the hang: BACK
both simulations hold the seat returning while the wave still runs

steps.assert: scene.refused(2, 'CARETAKEN') == 1 and scene.client(2).sim.tower_at(0, cell.x, cell.y) == null
steps.msg: the seat's own order is refused until the window, and builds nothing

steps.assert: Game.NOTICES[15] == 'The caretaker hands back at the next build window'
steps.msg: and the refusal says when it ends
the seat came back on the tick the build window opened

steps.assert: after_ready[0] == in_window[0] and after_ready[1] == in_window[1] + 1 and after_ready[2] > in_window[2]
steps.msg: in the window its Ready goes through: with seat 1 Ready the horn sounds early, and its early gold comes

steps.assert: scene.client(2).sim.tower_at(0, cell.x, cell.y) != null and scene.client(1).sim.tower_at(0, cell.x, cell.y).owner == 2 and scene.refused(2, 'CARETAKEN') == 1
steps.msg: and the BUILD refused before goes through
